reasons: R2 passed all 10 corrected-v1 deployment rollouts with no native collision and no numerical/control gate failure.
R2 audited 1874 valid prediction/control steps and consumed spatial modes 0, 1 and 2 under the corrected joint-mode mapping.
The maximum per-rollout P95 solver time was 0.1038007328 s, below the frozen 0.5 s runtime gate.
After a clean CARLA restart, all 10 accepted R2 rollouts began on attempt 1 and completed in approximately 16 minutes, making an 80-rollout matrix operationally feasible.
The user instructed continuation of the planned task and retained manual authority over server launch and monitoring.

r3_design.run_order: deterministic block randomisation within each init

claim_boundary: R3 is a prospective corrected evaluation on five newly generated in-distribution init groups. Five clusters provide strong directional/descriptive evidence but limited exact-inference resolution; zero observed collision cannot establish zero collision risk.
server_execution_policy: Code is committed and pushed locally; the user alone launches and monitors server jobs. No assistant-side upload, launch, stop or polling is authorised.
